## Levelized cost of energy
```{R}
url <- 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ericmkeen/sewanee_esus/master/02_energy_sector/levelized-cost-of-energy.csv'
econ <- read_csv(url)
econ %>% head()
```

```{r,warning = FALSE}
ggplot(econ,
       aes(x = year, 
           y = cost,
           color = source)
       ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, lty = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.18, lty = 2) +
  annotate(geom= 'text',
           x=1990, 0.2, size = 5, label = 'Range of fossil\n fule costs')
  
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
econ%>% 
  filter(year == 2020) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarize(cost = mean(cost, na.ra = TRUE)) %>%
  kable

```
